subject: The secret truth about people who scan conversations
preview_text: You're now part of a growing group who sees relationships differently. This changes everything.
body_paragraphs: I noticed something strange happening with our users. A pattern that didn't make sense at first. People who use the scanner aren't just checking texts—they're doing something radically different in their relationships.

You're now part of 800+ people who've decided to trust their gut instead of their excuses. We're becoming a quiet tribe of people who refuse to ignore that sinking feeling. Who choose clarity over confusion. Who break cycles instead of repeating them. This isn't about being paranoid—it's about being protected.

That's why the Relationship Health Dashboard exists. It's not just a feature—it's your private space to see patterns across ALL your conversations. The dashboard shows you what your best friend can't: the actual toxicity score trends, the manipulation patterns that repeat, the moments your gut was right all along.

Open the app right now and check your dashboard. See the bigger picture your gut already knows. P.S. The most dangerous red flags are the ones that feel normal—your dashboard shows you exactly which patterns you've started to accept as 'just how things are.'
